For too long, the Indian fitness industry has grown without structured accountability. Today, that changes.
Introducing FSSC — Fitness Standards & Safety Council.
FSSC is a public interest, independent standards body created to strengthen ethics, safety, and public trust in India’s rapidly expanding fitness industry.
Fitness shapes bodies, But responsibility shapes industries.
FSSC exists to:
• Elevate professional standards
• Encourage ethical boundaries
• Promote informed public awareness
